---
title: "Central Limit Theorem: an interactive simulation"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

The central limit theorem (CLT) concerns the *sample mean*, not the
shape of the individual observations. Use the controls below to draw many
independent samples from one population. Each trial contributes one sample
mean to the plot on the right.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to compare

Keep the distribution and number of trials fixed, then increase the sample
size. The distribution of sample means should become narrower and more nearly
bell-shaped. In contrast, increasing the number of trials only gives a clearer
view of that same sampling distribution.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="clt-explorer" class="clt-explorer" aria-label="Central limit theorem interactive simulation">
  <div class="clt-controls">
    <label>
      Underlying distribution
      <select id="clt-distribution">
        <option value="uniform">Uniform (0, 1)</option>
        <option value="binomial">Binomial (10, 0.2)</option>
        <option value="poisson">Poisson (λ = 3)</option>
        <option value="exponential">Exponential (mean 1)</option>
        <option value="normal">Normal (0, 1)</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Sample size, <i>n</i> (1–1,000)</span>
      <input id="clt-sample-size" type="number" min="1" max="1000" step="1" value="10" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Total trials, <i>B</i> (1–2,000)</span>
      <input id="clt-total-trials" type="number" min="1" max="2000" step="1" value="500" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      Add trials
      <select id="clt-batch-size">
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="5">5</option>
        <option value="10" selected>10</option>
        <option value="25">25</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Simulation controls">
    <button id="clt-add" type="button">Add trials</button>
    <button id="clt-run" type="button">Run remaining trials</button>
    <button id="clt-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="clt-status" class="clt-status" aria-live="polite">No trials yet. Add a small batch to begin.</p>

  <div class="clt-plots">
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption>Most recent sample <span class="clt-legend"><span class="clt-legend-bar"></span>observations <span class="clt-legend-line"></span>theoretical population</span></figcaption>
      <svg id="clt-current-sample" role="img" aria-label="Most recent random sample"></svg>
    </figure>
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption>Distribution of sample means</figcaption>
      <svg id="clt-sample-means" role="img" aria-label="Histogram of sample means"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Foundations</a>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("clt-explorer");
  if (!root) return;

  const distributionInput = document.getElementById("clt-distribution");
  const sampleSizeInput = document.getElementById("clt-sample-size");
  const totalTrialsInput = document.getElementById("clt-total-trials");
  const batchSizeInput = document.getElementById("clt-batch-size");
  const addButton = document.getElementById("clt-add");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("clt-run");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("clt-reset");
  const status = document.getElementById("clt-status");

  let means = [];
  let currentSample = [];

  const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));
  const getSampleSize = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(sampleSizeInput.value, 10) || 10, 1, 1000);
  const getTotalTrials = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(totalTrialsInput.value, 10) || 500, 1, 2000);

  function normalRandom() {
    const u = 1 - Math.random();
    const v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  function drawObservation() {
    switch (distributionInput.value) {
      case "binomial": {
        let successes = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) successes += Math.random() < 0.2 ? 1 : 0;
        return successes;
      }
      case "poisson": {
        const threshold = Math.exp(-3);
        let product = 1;
        let count = 0;
        do {
          count += 1;
          product *= Math.random();
        } while (product > threshold);
        return count - 1;
      }
      case "exponential":
        return -Math.log(1 - Math.random());
      case "normal":
        return normalRandom();
      default:
        return Math.random();
    }
  }

  function populationMoments() {
    switch (distributionInput.value) {
      case "binomial": return { mean: 2, sd: Math.sqrt(1.6), domain: [-0.5, 10.5] };
      case "poisson": return { mean: 3, sd: Math.sqrt(3), domain: [-0.5, 14.5] };
      case "exponential": return { mean: 1, sd: 1, domain: [0, 7] };
      case "normal": return { mean: 0, sd: 1, domain: [-4, 4] };
      default: return { mean: 0.5, sd: Math.sqrt(1 / 12), domain: [-0.1, 1.1] };
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    sampleSizeInput.value = getSampleSize();
    totalTrialsInput.value = getTotalTrials();
    means = [];
    currentSample = [];
    render();
  }

  function addTrials(requested) {
    const total = getTotalTrials();
    const numberToAdd = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, total - means.length));
    const n = getSampleSize();

    for (let trial = 0; trial < numberToAdd; trial += 1) {
      currentSample = Array.from({ length: n }, drawObservation);
      means.push(currentSample.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / n);
    }
    render();
  }

  function svgElement(tag, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function prepareSvg(id) {
    const svg = document.getElementById(id);
    const width = Math.max(300, Math.round(svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 560));
    const height = 250;
    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    return { svg, width, height, margin: { top: 16, right: 18, bottom: 34, left: 42 } };
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function addAxes(chart, domain, maximum, yLabel = "count") {
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => margin.left + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * plotWidth;
    const y = value => margin.top + plotHeight - (value / maximum) * plotHeight;

    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: y(0), x2: width - margin.right, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
      const value = domain[0] + (i / 4) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
      const tickX = x(value);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: tickX, y1: y(0), x2: tickX, y2: y(0) + 4, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, Number(value.toFixed(2)).toString(), tickX, height - 12, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
    if (yLabel) {
      const labelX = 14;
      const labelY = margin.top + plotHeight / 2;
      addText(svg, yLabel, labelX, labelY, {
        class: "clt-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        transform: `rotate(-90 ${labelX} ${labelY})`
      });
    }
    return { x, y, plotWidth, plotHeight };
  }

  function histogram(values, domain, binCount) {
    const bins = Array.from({ length: binCount }, () => 0);
    const width = (domain[1] - domain[0]) / binCount;
    values.forEach(value => {
      const index = clamp(Math.floor((value - domain[0]) / width), 0, binCount - 1);
      bins[index] += 1;
    });
    return { bins, width };
  }

  function density(value) {
    switch (distributionInput.value) {
      case "exponential": return value >= 0 ? Math.exp(-value) : 0;
      case "normal": return Math.exp(-(value ** 2) / 2) / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);
      case "uniform": return value >= 0 && value <= 1 ? 1 : 0;
      default: return 0;
    }
  }

  function binomialMass(k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > 10 || !Number.isInteger(k)) return 0;
    let coefficient = 1;
    for (let i = 1; i <= k; i += 1) coefficient *= (11 - i) / i;
    return coefficient * (0.2 ** k) * (0.8 ** (10 - k));
  }

  function poissonMass(k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > 14 || !Number.isInteger(k)) return 0;
    let mass = Math.exp(-3);
    for (let i = 1; i <= k; i += 1) mass *= 3 / i;
    return mass;
  }

  function drawCurrentSample() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("clt-current-sample");
    const moments = populationMoments();
    const domain = moments.domain;
    const isDiscrete = ["binomial", "poisson"].includes(distributionInput.value);
    const binCount = distributionInput.value === "binomial" ? 11 : distributionInput.value === "poisson" ? 15 : 16;
    const { bins, width: binWidth } = histogram(currentSample, domain, binCount);
    const n = currentSample.length || getSampleSize();
    const theoreticalCounts = distributionInput.value === "binomial"
      ? Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, k) => n * binomialMass(k))
      : distributionInput.value === "poisson"
        ? Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, k) => n * poissonMass(k))
      : Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => n * binWidth * density(domain[0] + (i / 100) * (domain[1] - domain[0])));
    const maximum = Math.max(...bins, ...theoreticalCounts, 1) * 1.12;
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const { x, y } = addAxes(chart, domain, maximum, "observations");

    bins.forEach((count, index) => {
      const start = domain[0] + index * binWidth;
      svg.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: x(start) + 1,
        y: y(count),
        width: Math.max(1, x(start + binWidth) - x(start) - 2),
        height: y(0) - y(count),
        class: "clt-current-bar"
      }));
    });

    if (isDiscrete) {
      theoreticalCounts.forEach((count, k) => {
        const pointX = x(k);
        svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: pointX, y1: y(0), x2: pointX, y2: y(count), class: "clt-theory-stem" }));
        svg.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: pointX, cy: y(count), r: 3.5, class: "clt-theory-point" }));
      });
    } else {
      const path = theoreticalCounts.map((count, index) => {
        const value = domain[0] + (index / 100) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
        return `${index === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(value)},${y(count)}`;
      }).join(" ");
      svg.append(svgElement("path", { d: path, class: "clt-theory-curve" }));
    }

    if (!currentSample.length) {
      addText(svg, "The theoretical population is shown in blue. Add trials to draw a sample.", width / 2, height / 2, { class: "clt-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle" });
      return;
    }

    const latestMean = means.at(-1);
    const meanX = x(latestMean);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: meanX, y1: margin.top, x2: meanX, y2: y(0), class: "clt-current-mean-line" }));
    addText(svg, `sample mean = ${latestMean.toFixed(3)}`, Math.min(meanX + 5, width - 105), margin.top + 12, { class: "clt-annotation" });
  }

  function drawSampleMeans() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("clt-sample-means");
    const moments = populationMoments();
    const n = getSampleSize();
    const theoreticalSd = moments.sd / Math.sqrt(n);
    const spread = Math.max(4 * theoreticalSd, 0.08 * (moments.domain[1] - moments.domain[0]));
    const observedMin = means.length ? Math.min(...means) : moments.mean - spread;
    const observedMax = means.length ? Math.max(...means) : moments.mean + spread;
    const domain = [Math.min(moments.mean - spread, observedMin - 0.08 * spread), Math.max(moments.mean + spread, observedMax + 0.08 * spread)];
    const { bins, width: binWidth } = histogram(means, domain, 28);
    const maximum = Math.max(...bins, 1);
    const { svg, width, margin } = chart;
    const { x, y } = addAxes(chart, domain, maximum);

    bins.forEach((count, index) => {
      const start = domain[0] + index * binWidth;
      svg.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: x(start) + 1,
        y: y(count),
        width: Math.max(1, x(start + binWidth) - x(start) - 2),
        height: y(0) - y(count),
        class: "clt-means-bar"
      }));
    });
    const meanX = x(moments.mean);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: meanX, y1: margin.top, x2: meanX, y2: y(0), class: "clt-mean-line" }));
    addText(svg, "population mean", Math.min(meanX + 4, width - 95), margin.top + 12, { class: "clt-annotation" });

    if (!means.length) {
      addText(svg, "The sample means will appear here.", width / 2, 125, { class: "clt-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
  }

  function render() {
    const total = getTotalTrials();
    const completed = means.length;
    const remaining = total - completed;
    drawCurrentSample();
    drawSampleMeans();
    status.textContent = completed
      ? `${completed} of ${total} trials completed. The most recent sample contains ${getSampleSize()} observations.`
      : "No trials yet. Add a small batch to begin.";
    addButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    runButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
  }

  addButton.addEventListener("click", () => addTrials(Number.parseInt(batchSizeInput.value, 10)));
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => addTrials(getTotalTrials() - means.length));
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  [distributionInput, sampleSizeInput, totalTrialsInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener("change", reset));
  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  reset();
})();
</script>
